payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: In the edited image, is the same woman's jacket fully closed, with no visible opening remaining along its front closure?
node.criteria: Pass only if the front panels meet along the entire visible closure and no opening remains. Fail if a visible opening remains or the closure is clearly not fully closed. Unknown if the closure is obscured or cannot be judged from the edited image; do not infer failure from low confidence alone.
node.binding: Assess the same woman's jacket identified in s1. Judge the edited image's visible front closure; the source is for garment identification, not a substitute for evidence of the edited endpoint. Full closure is required; partial closure is not complete fulfillment.
